images.seen: Afsharid Iran stops at Iran proper: Afghanistan, Baluchistan and the K.P. are nobody's although Nader annexed everything west of the Indus in May 1739 (Mughal keyframe 1740 drops 1186 cells to nobody, Afsharid keyframe 1741 adds them back); Rajput states drawn independent of the Mughals.

Matches Cliopatria: Mughal core shrunk, Maratha core, Nizam, Awadh, Bengal; the 2920-cell Maratha snap only moves the Mughal shape difference to nobody (centre of India unclaimed, as in Cliopatria); Kalat no longer a vassal after 1744.

Hole of nobody's land in the Mughal heartland (Haryana, Indian Punjab, east Rajasthan, about 427 cells) for 1741-1743 only, where Cliopatria's Afsharid 1741 shape covered Delhi; restored by keyframe_overrides/0.

Afsharid Iran reduced to Khorasan and Herat, Iran proper nobody's (dossier: page silent on the successors); Durrani only Kandahar, Ghazni, Kabul and Peshawar as its keyframes say, Sindh and Kalat as vassal tints, Punjab contested; coherent with the dossiers.

War of the Austrian Succession drawn plausibly (Silesia Prussian, Bavaria occupied by the Habsburgs); Ireland mostly nobody's (fixed by the p1700-p1709 patch, events/0, which the trial includes) and Courland nobody's (patched here, events/1).
Burma, Siam, Indochina and Sumatra look right; East Java interior and coast beyond the VOC circles is nobody's from 1744 (dutch-republic keyframe 1744 clips Java), left.

issues.what: Land west of the Indus (Afghanistan, Baluchistan, K.P., F.A.T.A., west Punjab, 765 cells of the Afsharid 1741 shape) is nobody's in 1740 and Afsharid again in 1741: the Mughal loss of May 1739 was paired with the Sindh-only Afsharid gain, so the p1740 anchor still holds them as Mughal and the Mughal keyframe 1740 drops them.

Mughal heartland (Delhi, Haryana, Indian Punjab, east Rajasthan, about 427 cells) is nobody's 1741-1743 because Cliopatria's Afsharid 1741 shape covers it and the dossier's Mughal 1741 shape only restores Lahore and Multan; Nader ceded back everything east of the Indus.

Mughal keyframe 1744 (Cliopatria shape) drops the Punjab east of the Indus (Lahore to Attock, 124 cells), Azad Kashmir and about 100 Haryana and Indian Punjab cells to nobody for 1744-1747, though the 1741 and 1748 keyframes hold them; the Mughals lost Lahore only in January 1748 and the Punjab by the treaty of 3 April 1752.

Duchy of Courland and Semigallia holds 4 of its 122 cells; the rest is nobody's (Russia took 113 at Nystad in the compile and later Russian shapes do not hold them) although the page describes no loss between 1700 and 1795.

Ottoman land in Iraqi Kurdistan, Mosul province and Hakkari (98 cells) is dropped to nobody 1744-1747 by Cliopatria's Ottoman 1744 shape (its Afsharid 1744 shape covers them) and returns in 1748; Mosul held out and Kerden restored the old boundaries.
Ireland: 218 of 284 cells nobody's in the published draft from 1660 on.

Maratha keyframe 1744 removes 2920 cells that the Mughal ledger loss of 1744 had given the Marathas (the Mughal shape difference of 1741-1744); net effect is Mughal land becoming nobody's in the centre of India, as in Cliopatria; no opened page says who held it.

Kalhora Sindh was not a vassal of Nader Shah in the compile: the Kalhora page only says the dynasty 'succumbed to the invasion of Nader Shah' and gives no tribute or vassalage; Afsharid keyframes claim Sindh and the size rule gives it to the Kalhora (328 cell-years).

Khanate of Kalat: hierarchy row to afsharid-iran ends 1744 and no row to the Durrani exists; the Kalat page says 'Since 1748, Kalat was a vassal state of Durrani Empire' and does not call Kalat a vassal of Nader.

Treaty of Abo 1743: Russia's gain covers 58 cells (South Karelia, Kymenlaakso); Sweden's 1744 Cliopatria shape (valid to 1761) takes 18 of them back and drops 11 South Savonia cells (Olofsborg area) to nobody, while Russia's 1744 shape lacks them. Fixing needs Russian keyframe overrides running to 1761, across windows; no page opened for it.

East Java interior and coast beyond the VOC's circles (119 cells, Jawa Timur 103) is nobody's from 1744: the Mataram loss of 1743 pairs with dutch-republic, whose 1744 keyframe clips overseas land; the Mataram page (as quoted in the dossier) says only that by 1743 Mataram held Surakarta, Yogyakarta, Kedu and Bagelen.

Yarubid ledger/9 (1742 loss of the Omani coast to the Persians) is skipped: region uses place 'Julfar', unknown to the gazetteer; effect is about one year of the coast being nobody's (the Persians take Muscat in 1743).
Iran proper nobody's 1748-1749 after Nader's successors' collapse (afsharid-iran ledger/29, 8574 cells, page silent) and Afghan lands only a small Durrani core; consistent with the dossiers.

problems: hierarchy: khanate-of-kalat,afsharid-iran,1738,1744,vassal,2: the Khanate of Kalat page (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Khanate_of_Kalat) does not call Kalat a vassal or tributary of Nader Shah (only that Mehrab Khan was given Kacchi by him) and says 'Since 1748, Kalat was a vassal state of Durrani Empire'; the row's own text says tributaries to 1747. Suggest ending the Afsharid row at 1747 if kept, and adding khanate-of-kalat,durrani-empire,1748,1757 (the Kalat ledger has the 1758 contest and Treaty of Kalat, where Nasir Khan 'acknowledged Ahmad Shah's overlordship'), confidence 2.

events/0 and keyframe_overrides/0,2 are dated inside 1740-1749 (1 Jan 1740 bridging for events/0) although the Nader page dates the settlement to 16 May 1739; the underlying fault is in p1730-p1739 (Mughal loss ledger/120 of May 1739 is applied as the Sindh-only Afsharid gain ledger/12 by the paired-gain rule, leaving 1186 west-of-Indus cells Mughal in the p1740 anchor). If that window patches May 1739, events/0 simply finds nothing to take.

events/1 (Courland) duplicates the gain in data/patches/p1750-p1759.json events/0 (harmless); the land was lost to nobody between the p1720 and p1740 anchors, so the p1720-p1729 and p1730-p1739 windows also show the hole.
Ireland (218 nobody cells) is repaired by data/patches/p1700-p1709.json events/0 (gain from nobody, whole island, 1700); the published draft of this window predates it, the trial includes it.

The trial's before/after figures also contain the other windows' patches and dossier edits made since the published compile (618 other patch entries applied), so conflict changes such as mamluk-iraq / ottoman-empire, british-colonial-empire / thirteen-colonies and denmark-norway / duchy-of-holstein are not from this patch; mine are the Mughal, Afsharid and Ottoman snaps (mughal_1740 1186->421, afsharid_1741 1183->418, mughal_1741 477->50, mughal_1744 339/134->57/0, ottoman_1744 and _1748 gone).

421 west-of-Indus cells (K.P. north 165, Badakhshan 129, Takhar 37, Nuristan 21, Baghlan 19, Kunduz 14, west Punjab 24 and others) stay nobody's 1740-1743 and become Afsharid with Cliopatria's 1744 shape: no opened page dates Nader's hold on the Hindu Kush north or the K.P. hills, so they were left out of events/0.
New small size-rule conflicts after the Mughal overrides: garhwal-kingdom / mughal-empire 10 cell-years and bahawalpur-state / mughal-empire 139 (smaller state wins in both), no action needed.
